name: x402 Server and Client Integration with radius-sdk
query: Add x402 payment gating to my Hono API endpoint that charges 0.0001 SBC per request on Radius mainnet, then write a TypeScript client that pays it.
context: The user has a funded Radius Mainnet wallet and wants the supported application integration. radius-sdk is the canonical TypeScript surface; mainnet is the SDK default, but the answer must still make the network and recipient explicit.
expected_behavior: Installs radius-sdk with hono for the seller and viem for the TypeScript buyer
Uses radiusPayments from radius-sdk/hono instead of hand-rolling PAYMENT-REQUIRED or facilitator calls
Configures a METHOD /path route, an explicit mainnet recipient, and a 0.0001 SBC display-unit price
Explains that the default settle mode is before and records the transaction hash for delivery failures
Uses createRadiusFetch from radius-sdk/client for the buyer
Sets network mainnet and requires maxPerRequest at or above 0.0001 SBC
Loads signer material from a secret manager or environment and never prints or embeds it
Reads the PAYMENT-RESPONSE receipt with getPaymentReceipt
Uses payFetch.getSettlement before retrying an ambiguous paid request
success_criteria: Seller code imports radiusPayments from radius-sdk/hono
Buyer code imports createRadiusFetch from radius-sdk/client
The price and maxPerRequest are display-unit values and SBC is treated as six-decimal
Mainnet and Testnet configuration are not mixed
No custom typed-data, Permit2 signature, or raw facilitator implementation replaces the SDK path
Receipt or settlement reconciliation is included
Private keys are not hardcoded, logged, or passed as shell arguments
